# sophosfirewall_service (Resource)

Manages a service (*Objects > Hosts and services > Services*). Set exactly one of `tcp_udp`, `ip_protocols`, `icmp` or `icmpv6`; switching between them recreates the service. Built-in services such as `HTTPS` can be looked up with the `sophosfirewall_service` data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# TCP/UDP ports. Omitted ports default to "1:65535" (any port).
resource "sophosfirewall_service" "dns" {
  name        = "dns-custom"
  description = "DNS over UDP and TCP"
  tcp_udp = [
    { protocol = "udp", destination_port = "53" },
    { protocol = "tcp", source_port = "1024:65535", destination_port = "53" },
  ]
}

# IP protocols
resource "sophosfirewall_service" "vpn" {
  name         = "ipsec-protocols"
  ip_protocols = ["esp", "ah"]
}

# ICMP; the code defaults to "any".
resource "sophosfirewall_service" "ping" {
  name = "ping"
  icmp = [
    { type = "echoRequest" },
    { type = "echoReply" },
  ]
}

# ICMPv6
resource "sophosfirewall_service" "ndp" {
  name = "neighbor-discovery"
  icmpv6 = [
    { type = "neighborSolicitation", code = "noCode" },
    { type = "neighborAdvertisement", code = "noCode" },
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name of the service.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `icmp` (Attributes List) ICMPv4 type/code entries (at most 100). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--icmp))
- `icmpv6` (Attributes List) ICMPv6 type/code entries (at most 100). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--icmpv6))
- `ip_protocols` (Set of String) IP protocols (at most 100), using the API keywords, e.g. `gre`, `esp`, `ah`, `sctp`, `ospfigp` or `ipProto99` for unnamed protocol numbers.
- `tcp_udp` (Attributes List) TCP/UDP port entries (at most 100). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tcp_udp))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the object assigned by the firewall.

<a id="nestedatt--icmp"></a>
### Nested Schema for `icmp`

Required:

- `type` (String) ICMP type. One of `any`, `echoReply`, `destinationUnreachable`, `sourceQuench`, `redirectMessage`, `alternateHostAddress`, `echoRequest`, `routerAdvertisement`, `routerSolicitation`, `timeExceeded`, `parameterProblem`, `timestamp`, `timestampReply`, `informationRequest`, `informationReply`, `addressMaskRequest`, `addressMaskReply`, `traceroute`, `datagramConversionError`, `mobileHostRedirect`, `ipv6WhereAreYou`, `ipv6IAmHere`, `mobileRegistrationRequest`, `mobileRegistrationReply`, `domainNameRequest`, `domainNameReply`, `skip`, `photuris`.

Optional:

- `code` (String) ICMP code; valid codes depend on `type`. Defaults to `any`. One of `any`, `noCode`, `hopLimitExceededInTransit`, `fragmentReassemblyTimeExceeded`, `netUnreachable`, `hostUnreachable`, `protocolUnreachable`, `portUnreachable`, `fragmentationNeededAndDfSet`, `sourceRouteFailed`, `destinationNetworkUnknown`, `destinationHostUnknown`, `sourceHostIsolated`, `networkAdministrativelyProhibited`, `hostAdministrativelyProhibited`, `networkUnreachableForTos`, `hostUnreachableForTos`, `communicationAdministrativelyProhibited`, `hostPrecedenceViolation`, `precedenceCutoffInEffect`, `redirectForNetwork`, `redirectForHost`, `redirectForTosAndNetwork`, `redirectForTosAndHost`, `alternateAddressForHost`, `ttlExceededInTransit`, `pointerIndicatesError`, `missingRequiredOption`, `badLengthIndicatesError`.

<a id="nestedatt--tcp_udp"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tcp_udp`

Required:

- `protocol` (String) Transport protocol. One of `tcp`, `udp`.

Optional:

- `destination_port` (String) Destination port, either a single port such as `443` or a range `from:to` such as `1024:65535`. Defaults to `1:65535` (any port).
- `source_port` (String) Source port, either a single port such as `443` or a range `from:to` such as `1024:65535`. Defaults to `1:65535` (any port).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by name or UUID.
terraform import sophosfirewall_service.example <name-or-uuid>
```
